subject.title: feat(ui): docs, help, Discord, and changelog links in the agent chip menu

question: Should the agent-chip menu permanently include Help, Discord community, and changelog links in addition to Docs once the viewport defect and proof gap are resolved?
rationale: This expands permanent product chrome, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human ownership of that UX direction rather than inferring acceptance from automated checks.

options.title: Approve the four-link menu
options.body: Keep Docs, Help, Discord, and changelog in the agent menu after the viewport repair, conflict resolution, and visible proof are complete.

options.title: Keep support links docs-only
options.body: Retain Docs and Help in product chrome but omit Discord or changelog to keep the utility menu smaller and product-focused.

options.title: Move links elsewhere
options.body: Keep the agent menu compact and place community or release links in a dedicated Help or About surface.

recommendation.title: Approve the four-link menu
recommendation.body: Keep Docs, Help, Discord, and changelog in the agent menu after the viewport repair, conflict resolution, and visible proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current agent-chip utility menu and have the strongest history-backed connection to this exact UI surface.
